P1: 烟墨市 is located in the northeast part of Johto, between the 冰雪小径 and 45号道路. It is a mysterious mountain village cut directly into the rock face. Many residents go on to become 龙 specialists, perhaps due to the proximity of the 龙穴, a large cave underneath the city. Only those with the Gym Leader's permission may enter this cave, by crossing the lake behind the Gym.
M1: The same as the traded Pokémon
D1: From Santos星期六, on a ledge to the southeast of the Gym
D2: From Santos星期六, after meeting all of the Week Siblings
D3: Held by Doris, a 嘟嘟利 received through a trade
D4: From a girl in the easternmost house, if the lead Pokémon has 510 EVs
P2: Visit the eastern house to find a girl who would like to trade Pokémon. She is willing to part with her 嘟嘟利 in exchange for a female 哈克龙. Dragonair can only be found with a high-end fishing rod, but its pre-evolved form, 迷你龙, can be found in the 龙穴.
P3: A second girl in the easternmost house will evaluate how much effort that your lead Pokémon has put toward growing stronger. If it has maxed out its potential and earned a total of 510 EVs, she awards the Pokémon an Effort Ribbon.
H4: Move Deleter and Move Tutor House
P4: The southern house belongs to a man known as the Move Deleter. Using his free service allows a Pokémon to forget one of its moves. This is especially useful for removing moves taught by HM, as they would normally be permanent.
P5: The house has three other residents, as well, and each of these Move Tutors is able to teach a certan set of moves.
P6: The man standing near the kitchen sink is the Pokémon Move Maniac. In exchange for one 心之鳞片, he can help a Pokémon relearn any move it had previously forgotten.
P7: The elderly woman is known as Grandma Wilma. When shown a 龙 Pokémon that is happy with its Trainer, she offers to teach it the ultimate Dragon-type attack, 流星群.
P8: The elderly man is able evaluate any fully-evolved first partner Pokémon. If it is happy with its Trainer, he offers to teach it the ultimate move of its type: 疯狂植物, 爆炸烈焰, or 加农水炮.
C1:
Blackthorn City Pokémon Gym
Leader: Clair
The Blessed User of Dragon Pokémon
P9: The Blackthorn Gym specializes in 龙 Pokémon. Dragon-type moves are super effective against Dragon-type Pokémon, while Dragon-type Pokémon are weak to Dragon- and 冰 moves.
P10: Shortly after entering the building, the Gym guide warns that the building's flooring is unstable and that Pokémon must be kept in their Poké Balls. The Gym features two stationary platforms lined with spikes, and three smaller stone platforms. Each of these has a blue button that rotates the platform, and two arrow buttons that move it in the respective direction. Challengers must use these buttons to direct these stone platforms across the lava and advance to the Gym Leader.
C5: Left Arrow, Center Button, Center Button, Right Arrow
C7: Up Arrow, Center Button, Right Arrow, Center Button, Center Button, Right Arrow
C9:

P11: Clair leads with her 暴鲤龙, a Flying Pokémon. Due to this typing, it sustains massive damage when hit by 电 attacks. Her two Dragonair have nearly identical movesets, except for a single attack. Having access to 大字爆炎 and 水流尾 gives Clair an advantage when facing two of Professor Elm's three Pokémon. As a part-水 Pokémon, her Kingdra takes serious damage only from 龙 attacks. Bring 麻痹-healing items, and use HP-restoring items often to keep from being caught off-guard by Kingdra's 破坏光线.
P12: After the battle, Clair is left in disbelief. She admits that she lost, but claims that you are still not ready for the Pokémon League, and insists that you take the "Dragon-master challenge". She informs you of the 龙穴, a large cave located under the city, and instructs you to visit the shrine found inside. Doing so proves your worth, and only then will she give up the Rising Badge. Bring a Pokémon with 冲浪 and 潮旋, and cross the lake to reach the cave entrance behind the Gym.
P13: The 龙穴 is a large cavern located underneath 烟墨市. It is a sacred home of 龙 Pokémon, and where the city's residents train to become Dragon-type specialists. A large shrine is located on a platform to the south.
M2: 1 只（Gift from the Dragon Master after receiving TM59 from Clair）

P14: Climb down the ladder to reach the main cavern. Battle Ace Trainer Kobe, then pick up the 特攻增强剂 to the southeast. 冲浪 to the southwest, collect the ＰＰ多项全补剂 on the western shore, then use 潮旋 to calm the waters. Continue eastward along the cavern's south wall and climb the eastern stairway to pick up a 龙之牙. Backtrack and enter the shrine.
P15: When you enter the shrine, you are met by the clan's elder. He realizes that you were sent by Clair, and explains that you must pass a quiz to determine your perception of Pokémon.
C16: What helps you to win battles?
C20: What kind of Trainer do you wish to battle?
C24: What is most important for raising Pokémon?
C28: Strong Pokémon. Weak Pokémon. Which is more important?
P16: The elder reviews your answers, and determines that you care deeply for Pokémon. He stresses the importance of never losing that conviction, as it will assist you at the Pokémon League. Clair enters a moment later, assuming that you have failed. She is shocked to learn that you passed the elder's test, as even she has not done so. The elder scolds her, telling her to admit defeat and award the 升龙徽章, or else he will inform Lance of her behavior. She reluctantly complies; this Badge ensures obedience from all Pokémon and enables the use of 攀瀑 in the field. She then leaves the shrine without a word. The elder then mentions the 漩涡岛, and how a Pokémon named 洛奇亚 is said to live there.
P17: Clair is waiting for you near the north end of the broken bridge. She apologizes for her behavior, and gives out 招式学习器59（龙之波动） as a prize. Now that you have earned all eight Badges in the Johto region, Clair tells you that your next step will be the Pokémon League at 石英高原. She advises you to 冲浪 east from 若叶镇, but mentions how the look on your face says that you have unfinished business. She warns you not to give up, regardless of what challenges lie ahead, or she will feel even worse for having lost to you.
P18: Having passed the elder's trial, you may return at any point with no more than five Pokémon in your party. Speak to the elder, and he entrusts you with a 迷你龙 as proof that he has recognized your worth. If every question was answered correctly, the Pokémon will know a special move, 神速, that it cannot otherwise learn. If not, it will know the move 瞪眼 instead.
P19: Upon leaving the cave, Professor Elm calls to ask that you visit him at the Lab, as he has something for you.
P20: 45号道路 is a rugged road leading down from the mountains around 烟墨市. The path splits and recombines multiple times, and the uneven terrain makes northbound travel impossible; this also forces travelers to visit multiple times to reach every area. The eastern entrance to 黑暗洞穴 is located on the north end of the route. The path eventually turns west at a small pond, where it connects to 46号道路.

P21: 黑暗洞穴 is a pitch-black cave network that runs underneath the eastern part of the region. Despite being first accessible from 31号道路, these tunnels are impossible to navigate without the field moves 冲浪, 怪力, and 碎岩, and difficult to do so without 闪光, as well. Alternate entrances exist on Routes 45号道路 and 46号道路.

P22: Turn west and walk down the two stairways, then use 冲浪 to continue southward. Pick up the 活力碎片 on the southeast ridge, then go west along the water's edge to find 招式学习器54（点到为止） on top of a ledge. Backtrack a bit and swim northward across the water, then walk westward along the ridge. Visit the northwest corner to find a shady man; you surprised him with your presence, and he gives you a pair of BlackGlasses to forget that you saw him here. Head south from here over several ledges to reach the cave's western chamber.
P23: To the west, there is a 伤药 sitting in the middle ground between two sets of ledges, if you have not collected it by now. Next, use 冲浪 to cross the small pool to the south for a 黑色玻璃哨. Afterward, use either 碎岩 or 冲浪 to move eastward, then use 怪力 to continue onward. Clear away another rock and loop around the northeast corner to reach a 厉害伤药. Jump the ledge and continue southward to pick up a 万灵药, then move southwest for a 要害攻击. The exit to 46号道路 is located to the south.
P24: 46号道路 connects 45号道路 and 29号道路. The rugged mountain road from 烟墨市 comes to an end here, as the mountains give way to hills. A small grove of Apricorn trees grows in a secluded field, to the west of the 黑暗洞穴 entrance.
